2026-07-26T19:46:56.0328825Z             "body": "Related to #1945 \r\n\r\nImplement the SageMaker control plane over the AWS JSON 1.1 protocol (X-Amz-Target: SageMaker.*) plus the runtime invocation path:\r\n\r\n- Models, endpoint configs, endpoints, training jobs, and tags with AWS-shaped validation errors (ValidationException / ResourceInUse)\r\n- CreateTrainingJob runs the training image as a real Docker container using the /opt/ml contract: hyperparameters, resourceconfig and inputdataconfig under /opt/ml/input/config, S3 channel data under /opt/ml/input/data/<channel>, and /opt/ml/model uploaded back to S3 as model.tar.gz under the configured S3OutputPath\r\n- CreateEndpoint hosts the model image as a long-lived container with the serve command, /ping health checks, and ModelDataUrl artifacts extracted into /opt/ml/model\r\n- POST /endpoints/{name}/invocations proxies to the container and maps model 5xx responses to ModelError (HTTP 424) like SageMaker Runtime\r\n- Training container logs stream to CloudWatch Logs under /aws/sagemaker/TrainingJobs\r\n- Storage wired through StorageFactory with memory/persistent modes, config in EmulatorConfig and both application.yml files\r\n- Unit, integration, and Docker-gated integration tests plus a boto3 compatibility test; service and docs registered in the catalog\r\n\r\n## Summary\r\n\r\n<!-- What does this PR do?
